Yawning Portal battle maps
--------------------------
Files in this folder (cellar.webp, 1st-floor.webp, 2nd-floor.webp, 3rd-floor.webp, roof.webp)
are bundled for Wayfarer hub gameplay. Source PNGs lived under dist/assets/Yawning Portal/.

Confirm redistribution rights before public/commercial deploy. A free download is not
automatically a redistribution license. Record artist/publisher here when known.
